tock.intro.text: I keep dates. One reminder each, at the time you pick.

tock.handful.dated.text: {title} closes {weekday}. I already started worrying for you.
tock.handful.dated.where: Today focus card, dated, no reminder yet

tock.handful.set.text: Reminder set for {weekday}. Quiet until then.

tock.reminder.push.text: Tock: {title} closes tomorrow. Want to see it?

tock.week.text: {n} things due this week. The first is {weekday}.

tock.room.text: {n} things with a date. The nearest is {date}.

tock.empty.text: Nothing with a date yet. Sign-ups, bookings and things due back land here.

tock.error.text: I couldn't read {n} new screenshots. They're still on your phone.
tock.error.where: Today error card, with Try again. Say "screenshot" when {n} is 1

murmur.intro.text: I keep chats. I never quote them back.

murmur.handful.text: {title}. I wrote it down and told no one.

murmur.code.text: The code from {title} is in here. I won't say it out loud.
murmur.code.where: Detail, chat with a code or password

murmur.plan.text: {title} is on {weekday}. That's all I'm repeating.

murmur.room.text: {n} conversations kept. Not a word repeated.

murmur.priming.text: Only your Screenshots album. I won't peek anywhere else.

murmur.empty.text: Nothing in Chats yet. Plans, codes and addresses land here.

murmur.credits.text: You found the credits. I'll tell no one.

murmur.error.text: The server didn't answer. I kept your question above.

penny.intro.text: I keep prices and receipts. Unclear amounts stay blank.

penny.reveal.text: I found {n} things with a price. One is {title}, due {date}.
penny.reveal.where: Import done, the one true fact

penny.due.where: Today focus card, bill. Plain, no joke

penny.refund.text: {amount} refund marked pending on the {date} receipt.
penny.refund.where: Today focus card, receipt with a refund line

penny.wishlist.text: {amount} when you saved it, {date}. Prices change.
penny.wishlist.where: Thin day, product page. Facts only, no prompt to buy

penny.room.text: {n} things with a price. The next one due is {date}.

penny.unclear.text: I couldn't read the amount on {title}, so I left it blank.

penny.empty.text: Nothing with a price yet. Receipts, bills and tickets land here.

mote.intro.text: I keep ideas. One may come back to Today on a quiet day.

mote.thinday.text: Nothing urgent today, so here's one from the jar. {title}, saved {date}.

mote.recipe.text: {title}. {n} weeks in the jar. Still sounds delicious.
mote.recipe.where: Today focus card or detail, recipe

mote.room.text: {n} ideas saved. The oldest has waited since {date}.

mote.kept.text: Kept. Back in the jar for another day.

mote.reminder.push.text: Mote: you saved {title} {n} weeks ago. Tonight, maybe?
mote.reminder.push.where: Notification, only for a reminder the user set on an idea

mote.empty.text: Nothing in Ideas yet. Recipes, places and quotes land here.

system.handful.caption.text: Brought to you today. {n} left in today's handful.

system.thinday.text: Nothing urgent today, so here is one from the pile.

system.alldone.text: That's today's handful. Quiet from here until something needs you.

system.unsorted.text: {n} screenshots didn't fit a room. You decide where they go.

system.partial.text: Psst can see only the screenshots you picked. That works.

system.denied.text: Psst can't see your screenshots yet.
system.denied.where: Photo access denied, one button that asks again

system.ask.nomatch.text: I couldn't find that in your screenshots.
system.ask.nomatch.where: Ask, no match. App voice, no keeper

system.ask.nomatch.keeper.text: Maybe it's in {room}? Have a look.
system.ask.nomatch.keeper.where: Ask, the one keeper row under the closest screenshots
system.ask.nomatch.keeper.voice: keeper: the room keeper it points to

system.sync.error.text: Couldn't sync. Check your connection and try again.

system.notif.primer.text: Only for reminders you set. You can turn them off in Settings.

system.reminder.fired.where: Today focus card, after a reminder fired
